description: A metric-to-icon gauge for Power BI — bind a value and a target, and the icon itself carries the reading. The vessel fills in proportion, and its colour follows the health band, so the state is readable before anyone reads the number. Codex Icon Gauge is built for the single KPI that needs to be understood at a glance from across the room — a wallboard, a report header, a status tile on a floor screen. IDEAL FOR A single headline KPI read against its target Wallboards and floor displays where the glyph must carry the message Status tiles where colour is the message and the number is the detail Dashboards that need a friendlier read than a bar or a dial KEY FEATURES Four display modes — fill vessel, icon row, traffic light and state morph Six vessels for fill mode: bolt, battery, droplet, heart, person and thumb State morph in three styles — faces, thumbs or tick/cross Three health bands, derived automatically: at or over target, within 10% of target, and below Optional headline value and subtitle, each switchable Full font control — family, size, bold, italic, underline, colour and alignment — on the title, value and label Background colour with transparency, border with width, colour and radius Card signature accent with style, colour, corner radius and mirrored corners Custom tooltips through the Tooltips field well Keyboard focus support…
